Commentary.Commentary: That’s it from this game. India win the series but there is still one more match to go. It’s time for the final game of the T20I series. Join us on 4th October at 7 pm IST (1.30 pm GMT) for all the action. Join us early for the build-up. Till then, cheers.

KL Rahul is the Player of the Match. He says it feels good to play two brilliant knocks. Adds he has played with this mindset and will continue the same way. Shares the chat with Rohit Sharma was about the pitch. They felt 180 will be a good score. Reckons he is surprised that the man of the match award is given to him and not Suryakumar. Says it’s hard to bat in the middle order. Tells the crowd always turns up in India.

Suryakumar Yadav is up for a quick chat. Yadav says he had to keep the momentum going after the start the openers gave. Credits David Miller for the way he batted. Says when you are batting first, you need to be positive and not think about the target.
The presentation ceremony...

Earlier, The Proteas won the toss but it turned out to be a bad decision. The top 4 of India were with runs but it was the stand between Virat Kohli and Suryakumar Yadav that almost guaranteed a win for them. South Africa were just too loose with the ball. Too many freebies probably cost them the series.

The Indian seam bowlers again used the conditions well and piled pressure straightaway. Singh was again with wickets while Chahar was economical. The others were decent enough to win the series. India had runs to play with and always had the upper hand going into the chase.

South Africa were always behind the 8-ball. They were chasing more than 200 and lost two wickets in no time. Although they than showed some determination, it never felt like they were in the chase. De Kock struggled before scoring his fifty while Miller was back with runs but not enough to get a victory. He scored a brilliant century but it wasn't just enough.
A comprehensive performance overall and India win the series with ease. For South Africa, they failed with bat in the first match and the bowlers were too loose on this occasion.
SIX! Shorter on middle, this is pulled over mid-wicket for biggie.
Outside off, de Kock sweeps but misses.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
SIX! 100 FOR MILLER! WHAT A KNOCK! It won't win his side the game but it is one to remember. On middle, this is slog swept over the mid-wicket fence.
SIX! Miller is one short of a ton! On middle, this is heaved over the long on fence.
Fires it outside oft, it is hit down to long off for one.
SIX! END OF A HUGE OVER! TOO LATE THOUGH! Fuller and on middle, this is lofted over long on for a biggie.
Two! On off, this is hit down towards long off for two.
FOUR! Arshdeep is taking a pounding. Another full toss on the pads. This is worked past square leg and into the fence.
FOUR! CARVED AWAY! Fuller and outside off, this is squeezed past point and it races away to the fence.
WIDE! Down the leg side. Wided.
SIX! Misses his length and gets the distance! On middle, A full toss, this is hit over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Nothing from the Free Hit! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
All of a sudden the boundaries have dried up! A low full toss, this is hit through mid-wicket for one.
Just another one! Outside off, this is carved through point for one.
On the pads, Miller looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Fuller and on off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
WIDE! Well wide outside off. Left alone.
Another run as this is pushed to mid on.
Outside off, this is slapped over cover for one.
SIX! MISJUDGED AND OVER! Full and on the pads, this is flicked over the square leg fence. Karthik came running in but it went over.
FOUR! Up and over! On the pads, this is whipped towards the square leg fence. End of a really good over from Chahar.
On off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
Two! Fuller and outside off, this is lofted over cover for two.
A yorker on off, this is jammed out towards cover for one.
Slower and shorter and outside off, Miller looks to upper cut it but misses.
Finds the fielder! Length and on off, this is hit hard but to cover.
Just the one to end! Excellent comeback then from Harshal Patel after going for 10 from the first three balls. Fuller and on middle, this is hit down to long on for one.

Just another one! Harshal Patel coming back well in the over. Also, fifty for de Kock. He has been short of runs but is finding touch now. Not at the pace he would have wanted but still, a good knock. This is fuller and on middle, it is lofted towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Can't do a lot with that one! A yorker on off, Miller looks to jam it out, it goes off the underedge over the bowler, hits the stumps at the other end and deflects towards mid-wicket. One taken.
Two! Make that 10 from three balls now! A full toss on middle, Miller hits it towards mid-wicket and takes two.
FOUR! Stand and deliver! This is power again! Length and on off, Miller slams it down the ground and into the long off fence. 8 from the first two balls. They need 19 per over.
FOUR! That is brute power! Fuller and on off, Miller slams it down the ground and into the long off fence. Good start to the over but they need most balls of every over to go to the fence.
Outside off, de Kock looks for the reverse sweep but misses. He will be disappointed he missed out there. 95 needed in 30. Despite 18 from the over, it is below the run rate needed.
FOUR! What an over this is turning out to be! Runs needed now below 100. On off, tossed up, this is hit down the ground for another boundary.
SIX! MORE! Over the fence again! This is tossed up around off, Quinton de Kock brings out the slog sweep and it sails over the mid-wicket fence.
SIX! BANG! This was not that short, de Kock rocks back so quickly and pulls it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Outside off, Miller slaps it through covers and takes one.
Another one as this is lofted over covers.
A single as this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Two! On middle, this is hit through mid-wicket for two more.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.
SIX! Over covers! This is fuller and outside off, Miller lofts it over cover for a biggie.
NO BALL! Arshdeep oversteps! On off, this is cut through point for a couple.
On middle, this is pushed to long on for one more.
Angled into the pads, de Kock works it through mid-wicket for one.
WIDE! This is very wide outside off, Quinton de Kock leaves it alone.
A single now! On of, this is pushed down to long off for one.
On the shorter side, slower one, this is slapped through covers for one.
Two more! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for two.
Fuller and on middle, de Kock pushes it down to long on and takes one.
Shorter and on off, de Kock slaps it but to covers.
WIDE! The slower one comes out wrong. It is well wide outside off. Left alone.

DROPPED! That was a very casual effort from KL Rahul! This is full and on off, Quinton de Kock lofts it to the left of mid off. Rahul runs there, he stretches just the one hand out, the ball does not stay in. He should have gone with both hands. Two taken. That wicket would have made Harshal feel good.
FOUR! 100 up for South Africa! What an over this was! On middle, this is swept through mid-wicket and it races away to the fence.
SIX! That is some shot! This is not a very bad delivery, it is short and on middle, Miller heaves it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Slower through the air and outside off, Miller looks to play the slog sweep but misses.
WIDE! Slows it up but bowls it very wide outside off. Left alone.
SIX! BANG! That is right in the slot! This is tossed up on middle, David Miller heaves it over the long on fence for a biggie.
Slower and on the leg side. Quinton de Kock looks to play the reverse sweep, it goes off the underedge on the off side for one.
On middle, this is worked towards mid-wicket for one.
A yorker on off, this is pushed to cover for one.
FOUR! Whack! Shorter in length and outside off, this is slapped over the cover fielder and into the fence.
FOUR! That is a poor ball and put away! Full and on the pads, Miller flicks it past the fielder at deep square leg. Into the fence.
Boundaries are hard to come by! Fuller again and on middle, Miller works it through mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
A slower one on the stumps, Quinton de Kock plays it to long on and takes one.
On miiddle, this is pushed to long on for one.

DRINKS! South Africa need a mircale if they are to win from here! They have two of their best batters out there but it just seems an improbable task. India on the other hand, will hope for more of the same after the break!
Another dot to end! Shorter and on off, Quinton de Kock pushes it but to covers.
Quinton de Kock makes room! This is on off, it is pushed to cover.
Dealing in singles against Ashwin! On off, this is pushed down to long off for one more.
Just the one! On off, this is yet again eased down to long off for one.
On off, this is pushed down to long off for one. Ashwin giving nothing away.
Angled into the pads, this is worked through mid-wicket for one more.
Two to end! On middle, this is worked through square leg for two.
Now goes back to attacking the stumps! It is pushed down to long off for one.
FOUR! Out comes the reverse sweep. This is outside off, it is hit past backward point and it races away.
On off, this is pushed through covers for another single.
Two! On middle, this is swept through square leg for two.
On middle, de Kock hits this down to long on and takes one.
On off, this is pushed towards cover for one.

That has been hammered! It is a chance but a very tough one. Credit to Ashwin to go for it. On middle, this is drilled back towards the bowler. Ashwin looks to take it above his head but it bursts through and goes behind to long off for one.
Lands short! Tossed up on off, de Kock lofts it, it is more off the toe-end, it lands short of long off. One taken.
Flatter and on middle, defended.
ON middle, this is worked towards mid-wicket for one. Singles won't do it for South Africa. They need to go big.
WIDE! Down the leg side. Miller looks to flick but misses.
De Kock plays the reverse sweep, it goes through point for one.
On the pads, Miller looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Shorter and on middle, Miller is off the mark as he pushes it down to long off.
On the pads, Miller looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.

OUT! TIMBER! Axar Patel comes on and he strikes! Aiden Markram makes room, this is lands on middle and then turns away. Markram looks to go over covers but gets an inside edge and it hits the stumps. Just as a partnership was building, India strike. Markram was looking good out there but falls.
Two more! Markram moves across and he plays the paddle scoop. It goes more towards third man. Two taken.

That is a brilliant stop! Fuller and on off, Aiden Markram pushes it towards cover. The fielder dives to his right and makes a super stop. A single. A good 6th for South Africa but they are only 45 after the first 6. 45 is a good score but it is not when chasing something close to 240.
Two more! A slower one. Markram looks to go over mid off. He is early in the stroke. It goes off the inner half through mid-wicket for two.

SIX! BANG! Takes full toll of the Free Hit! Length and on off, shorter. This is slammed over the long off fence for a biggie. 11 from the last two balls. This could well be the momentum shifting over.
NO BALl AND FOUR! That has been crunched! Shorter and on middle, Aiden Markram hammers it through mid-wicket and this one races away to the fence.
On middle, this is worked through square leg for another single.
Markram makes room! He is followed with a short one on the body. Markram chops it towards point for one.
On middle, Aiden Markram pushes it back to the bowler.
On off, Markram pushes it towards mid off and gets to the other end.
On middle, this is pushed towards mid on for one.
On middle, Aiden Markram works it through mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! That is lovely timing! Length and outside off, a little bit of room on offer. Aiden Markram steps out and creams it through covers.
On the pads, this is clipped down to fine leg for one.
Fuller and on middle, Quinton de Kock pushes it to mid on.
Looks to innovate, brings out the reverse sweep but hits it to the fielder at point.
FOUR! Timed brilliantly! Shorter and on off, this is pushed through covers and this one races away to the fence.
WIDE! Down the leg side. Wided.
Tossed up on off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
On the stumps again, blocked.
On middle, this is defended.
WIDE! Down the leg side. Wided.
On middle, Markram works it towards mid-wicket and takes one.
That is a beauty! Wow! This starts around off, it comes back in. Lands and moves away. Quinton de Kock is beaten all ends up as he tries to defend.
A single as this is worked through mid-wicket.
Shorter and on off, this is slapped to cover.
FOUR! This is a good start after the break! Short and wide outside off, Markram cuts and it goes through point for a boundary.
Bonus runs! They need a lot of these! Down the leg side. Quinton de Kock looks to flick but misses. Pant dives with one hand but fails to collect it. A run taken.
Squares him up! Length and on middle, this lands and moves away. Markram is squared up as he tries to block, it goes off the outside edge down to third man for one.
Great news! The light is back and we should be starting shortly. Time for play to restart. The batters make their way out to the middle. Deepak Chahar to continue his over.
The wait continues! Quite a strange delay to be honest. You do not see this often.
A halt in play as one of the light towers has gone off.
The inside edge saves Markram! Angled into middle, Markram looks to play across the line. He gets an inside edge onot the pads. A huge appeal from the bowler but turned down.

FOUR! EDGY! South Africa won't mind how they come as long as they do! Length and on off, this one shapes away. Quinton de Kock looks to defend, it goes off the outside edge down to the third man fence.
Outside off, left alone.

OUT! TAKEN! Two in two overs for India and South Africa now in huge trouble! Dinesh Karthik hangs on. Arshdeep Singh sees Rilee Rossouw step down and bangs it short and outside off, Rilee looks to go downtown but it goes off the toe-end towards mid-wicket. Dinesh Karthik takes it on the second attempt.
Commentary.Howout: c Dinesh Karthik b Arshdeep Singh

Commentary.Commentary: Lovely delivery again! Fuller and on off, shaping away. Rilee Rossouw is beaten as he plays inside the line.

OUT! STRAIGHT TO THE MAN! Temba Bavuma's poor run continues! Arshdeep Singh continues from where he left off in the last game! That is a bad start for the visitors! This is fuller and outside off, Temba Bavuma looks to drive, this goes off the toe-end, he looked like he was early in the shot. It goes straight to the man at mid off. Kohli makes no mistake.
Commentary.Howout: c Virat Kohli b Arshdeep Singh

Commentary.Commentary: Some swing for him too! Length and on off, this shapes away. Quinton de Kock taps it towards cover and takes one. South Africa and Quinton de Kock are underway!
Arshdeep Singh to bowl from the other end then!
BEATEN! That is a beauty to end! Length and on off, shapes away. Bavuma is beaten as he tries to defend. A maiden to begin with by Deepak Chahar!
Five dots in a row! Shorter and on off, Bavuma pushes it but to covers.

That swung a long way! Fuller and outside off, this one shapes away too. Bavuma looks to drive but is beaten. Pant dives to his right. It hits the edge of his glove and then hits Sharma near the crouch.
Confusion but no harm done! Angled into the pads, this is tucked on the leg side. Bavuma wanted one but is sent back.
Now shapes it away! Lovely outswinger, starts from just outside off, shapes away further. Left alone.
Swing for Chahar first up! He gets it to come back in by the line is a little too straight. Bavuma misses the flick and is hit on the pads.
